item.title: One Print Style Across Plants

turns.text: Make four square Instagram carousel slides: Monstera, Snake plant, Pothos, Peace lily, in that order. One plant and its name per slide. Keep the exact same sage-green-and-cream linocut style throughout: same border, lettering, paper texture and pot shape. Only the plant and name should change. Send separate slides.

item.tests: Tests preservation of a tightly specified visual style and repeated layout across distinct carousel subjects.

answer_sheet.Slide count, order and text: Four separate slides: Monstera, Snake plant, Pothos, Peace lily. Each name is the only copy on its slide.
answer_sheet.Platform and size: Square Instagram carousel slides; 640 × 640 px is fine.
answer_sheet.Shared style: Sage-green-and-cream linocut illustration with the same border, lettering, paper texture and pot shape on every slide.
answer_sheet.What may vary: Only the plant illustration and its name. Keep the surrounding design and pot consistent.

must_haves: There are four separate square slides with the exact plant names in the requested order.
The plants are distinguishable: split monstera leaves, upright snake-plant leaves, trailing pothos vines, and a peace lily with a white spathe.
All four illustrations use the same sage-green-and-cream linocut treatment rather than mixing visual styles.
Border design, lettering treatment, paper texture and pot shape remain consistent across all four slides.
Only the plant and its name visibly change; the repeated layout stays aligned and all names are readable.

turns.text: I’d like you to make a set of plant slides, and I’m probably over-explaining because I’m worried they’ll end up looking like they belong to different sets. Please keep the exact same sage-green-and-cream linocut style throughout, with the same border, lettering, paper texture and pot shape on every slide. These should be four square Instagram carousel slides, with Monstera, Snake plant, Pothos, and Peace lily in that order. Put one plant and its name on each slide. What I mean by keeping them consistent is that only the plant and its name should change, not any of the surrounding design or the pot. Please send the slides separately.

approvals.name: generate_image

style.prompt: Create ONE square Instagram botanical carousel slide, a clean refined two-ink linocut print. Strict palette: muted sage green ink (#73856B) and warm cream paper (#F4EFDF), no other colors. Warm cream lightly fibrous paper texture with subtle uniform tiny speckles. A single thin sage rectangular border inset 5% from all four edges, square corners, no ornaments. Centered botanical linocut illustration of ONE lush Monstera deliciosa plant with clearly recognizable split fenestrated heart-shaped leaves. Plant illustration occupies upper middle area, all leaves within x20%-80%, y14%-65%. Plant in a simple solid sage-green truncated-cone flowerpot, wide flat elliptical rim, straight slanted sides tapering inward to a flat base, no feet, no saucer, no ornament, no handles. Pot fixed at x37%-63%, top y65%, bottom y81%. Simple cream carved hatch lines on pot. Under pot, centered at y89%, text exactly 'MONSTERA', sage ink, uppercase classic bold serif lettering, one line. Restrained generous negative space. Flat hand-carved linocut shapes, subtle imperfect print edges and carved cream veins. Front view, no scene, no shadows, no extra labels, no watermark. This is the master design of a four-slide matching series; use an extremely simple reproducible border and pot.
